title: [ingest] feat(planner): learnings-aware planning — dedup against rejected approaches
summary: get_learnings() now returns a digested rejected[] ledger so the planner can scan losing approaches in one pass instead of hand-parsing nested verdicts: - daemon.js: new pure helper digestRejected(verdicts, failures, labelFor) — verdict losers -> {approach, reason, beatenBy, source:'verdict'}; genuine dead-end failures -> {approach, reason, source:'failure'}, excluding superseded/duplicate/consolidated.
